title: The Stag and the Vine
summary: The stag hid beneath the vine from hunters, and then ate the leaves that sheltered him. The rustling attracted the hunters, who pierced him with arrows....
full_text: The stag hid beneath the vine from hunters, and then ate the leaves that sheltered him. The rustling attracted the hunters, who pierced him with arrows.
moral: Ingratitude toward your protector brings swift retribution.
